summary: Tested backend APIs and frontend flows for ANUYORA preview. Core pages, SEO, responsive layout, contact validation, and real form submit worked. Found critical email delivery integration failure and inconsistent rate-limit behavior across requests.

critical.issue: Owner notification failed on real submission; response had email_notification=failed. Backend log shows Emergent email API 422 undeliverable_recipient for contact@anuyora.com.
Rate-limit behavior is inconsistent in shared environment runs (sometimes no 429 in 6 requests, sometimes immediate/split 429), indicating process/instance-local limiter behavior.

integration_issues.issue: Submission succeeds and persists enquiry, but owner email notification status is failed due to upstream recipient verification rejection.

issues: Trademark marker appears very small/subtle at desktop scale; verify final readability expectation for ™ beside wordmark.

action_items: Fix owner email recipient deliverability with provider so /api/contact persists email_notification=sent and non-empty email_id for owner notification path.
Replace in-memory per-process rate limiter with shared/distributed store-backed limiter (or ingress-level limiter) for deterministic max 5/600 enforcement.
Optionally tighten mobile menu E2E reliability selectors/timing in automation around nav-click transitions (intermittent Playwright click race seen).
critical_code_review_comments: Rate limiter uses module-level in-memory deque keyed by request.client.host; this is not stable across multi-process/instance traffic and is reset on reload.
Backend correctly excludes MongoDB _id from API responses for /api/status and /api/contact response model.
Email integration catches send exceptions and returns success to user with failed status persisted; this is good UX resilience but requires alerting/monitoring for failed notifications.
seed_data_creation: Created test enquiries/status records via automated tests using ANUYORA QA test values.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Real browser submission enquiry_id=5d90fad0-cdf3-41e6-8854-3697e2dad38d persisted with email_notification=failed. Backend logs confirm 422 undeliverable_recipient for contact@anuyora.com. Most UI checks passed: 5 pages + 404, route SEO, responsive widths, FAQ keyboard, validation/focus/checkbox/radio behavior, schema/contact details, intercepted failure/rate-limit messaging with preserved answers.
rca of the issue: Email failure RCA: /api/contact inserts enquiry, then send_email() posts to managed email API; provider returns 422 with code undeliverable_recipient for OWNER_EMAIL contact@anuyora.com, causing backend to persist email_notification=failed and email_id=null. Rate-limit RCA: limiter state is in-memory (_RATE defaultdict/deque), so behavior varies with worker/pod routing and reload lifecycle; non-deterministic enforcement observed in repeated test runs.
